name: Clarification Dialog - Human In The Loop
description:
Opens a configurable dialog to request clarification, precision, additional information, etc. and outputs the information given by the user.

Use it inside tools and workflows as a human-in-the-loop component.

You can configure the :
- title of the dialog
- text of the dialog
- labels of the 'submit' and 'ignore' buttons.

When included inside another tool using Hanzo's AI tool building assistant, the LLM should be able to automatically adapt the title, text, and buttons of the dialog to suit your tool.

You can couple this tool with the Prompt Processor to process the extra information returned from the user and enrich the next step in your tool flow.
author: hanzo.ai
